result.instructions: Tools for Bird, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Bird data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run bird_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run bird_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run bird_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. bird_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List contacts (CRM records) in the workspace, newest first, as a cursor page. Bird API: GET /v1/contacts.

starting_after.description: Cursor from a previous response's `next_cursor` field, to fetch the next page.

tools.name: bird_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: Creates a contact (CRM record) in Bird — additive, sends no message. Contacts are unique by email. Bird API: POST /v1/contacts.

email.description: The contact's email address (unique within the workspace).

external_id.description: Your own identifier for this contact (unique within the workspace).

data.description: Custom property values. Each key must be a property created via the contact-properties API; values match the property's declared type.

tools.name: bird_create_audience
tools.title: Create an audience
tools.description: Creates an audience (contact list) in Bird — additive, sends no message. Static audiences start empty. Bird API: POST /v1/audiences.

description.description: Longer description of who this audience is.

type.description: How members are determined. Only `static` is generally available.
